sources.label: Pet Simulator Wiki - XP Potion Machine
Pet Simulator Wiki - Upgrade Potions Machine

notes: Final row count remained 65 after row-level verification: 56 standard tier rows, 3 special potions, and 6 XP or Ultra XP potions.

Exact standard potion upgrade costs and higher-tier requirements conflict between the main potions page and Upgrade Potions Machine page, so card rows use safe upgrade routing instead of exact disputed cost facts.
Lucky Eggs effects are written as normal egg luck only and should not imply exclusive eggs are affected.
Huge Hunter is limited to its stated active Huge luck boost and duration. No exact Huge odds or guarantee language should be used.
Images are intentionally blank until clean row-representative potion icons are gathered locally.
